```{r}
# --- Store results

AIC = matrix(NA, 5)
BIC = matrix(NA, 5)
H2 = matrix(NA, 5)
```

```{r}
boxplot(df$value~df$row)
boxplot(df$value~df$col)
```

#### **Model 1**
$$
y_{ijk} = \mu + C_k+B_j+G_i+e_{ijk}
$$

- $\mu$ Overal mean

- $C_k$ Vector of fixed checks effects

- $R_j$ Vector of fixed blocks effects

- $G_i$ Vector of random genotypes effects, $\sim N(0, I\sigma_g^2)$

- $e_{ijk}$ Vector of random residual effects, $\sim N(0, I\sigma_{e}^2)$

```{r}
M1 = asreml(value ~ 1 + check+rep, 
            random = ~clone,
            na.action = na.method(x = 'include'),
            residual = ~idv(units),
            data = df)
M1 = update(M1)

AIC[1] = as.numeric(summary(M1)$aic[1])
BIC[1] = as.numeric(summary(M1)$bic[1])
H2[1] = as.numeric(vpredict(M1, H2~V1/(V1+V2))[1])
```

```{r}
M1r = asreml(value ~ 1+check+rep,
            na.action = na.method(x = "include"),
            residual = ~idv(units),
            data = df)

lrt(M1, M1r, boundary = T)
```


#### **Model 2:**(AR1 x AR1) 

Modeling autoregressive correlation of residuals (AR1 x AR1)

$$
y_{ijk} = \mu+C_k+B_j+G_i+e_{ijk}
$$

- $e_{ijk}$ Vector of random residual effects, $\sim N(0, \sigma_e\Sigma_r(\rho_r)\otimes\Sigma_c(\rho_c))$

```{r}
M2 = asreml(value ~ 1+check+rep,
            random = ~ clone,
            na.action = na.method(x = 'include'),
            residual = ~ar1(row):ar1(col),
            data = df)
M2 = update(M2)

AIC[2] = as.numeric(summary(M2)$aic[1])
BIC[2] = as.numeric(summary(M2)$bic[1])
H2[2] = as.numeric(vpredict(M2, H2~V2/(V1+V2))[1])

plot(varioGram(M2))
```

```{r}
M2r = asreml(value ~ 1+check+rep,
            na.action = na.method(x = 'include'),
            residual = ~ar1(row):ar1(col),
            data = df)

lrt(M2, M2r)
```

#### **Model 3:** AR1, with fixed column
$$
y_{ijkl} = \mu +C_k+B_j+COL_l+G_i+e_{ijkl}
$$

- $\mu$ Overal mean

- $C_k$ Vector of fixed checks effects

- $B_j$ Vector of fixed blocks effects

- $COL_l$ Vector of fixed collumns effects

- $G_i$ Vector of random genotypes effects, $\sim N(0, I\sigma_g^2)$

- $e_{ijkl}$ Vector of random residual effects, $\sim N(0, \Sigma_r(\rho_r)\otimes\Sigma_c(\rho_c))$

```{r}
df$Fcol = 1
df$Fcol[df$col %in% seq(1,12,2)] = 2
df$Fcol<- factor(as.numeric(trimws(df$Fcol)))

df$Frow = factor(as.numeric(df$row))

M3 = asreml(value ~ 1+check+rep+Fcol,
            random = ~clone,
            na.action = na.method(x = "include"),
            residual = ~ar1(row):ar1(col),
            data = df)
M3 = update(M3)

AIC[3] = as.numeric(summary(M3)$aic[1])
BIC[3] = as.numeric(summary(M3)$bic[1])
H2[3] = as.numeric(vpredict(M3, H2~V1/(V1+V2))[1])
```


```{r}
M3r =asreml(value ~ 1+check+rep+Fcol,
            na.action = na.method(x = "include"),
            residual = ~ar1(row):ar1(col),
            data = df)

lrt(M3, M3r)
```


#### **Model 4:** Nearest neighbour adjustment - 0 additional layers
Moving grid adjustment is most common for unreplicated trials, at early stage for mass selection in single plant evaluation.

Grid is computed around each cell, and the mean of the cells included in the grid is calculated. The moving mean is computed as:

$$
x_i = \frac{\sum_j p_{j,obs} I(p_{j,obs} \in G_i)}{\sum_j I(p_{j,obs} \in G_i)}
$$

$$
p_{i,adj} = p_{i, obs} -b(x_i -\bar{x})
$$
$$
p_{i,adj} = a+bx_i
$$
$$
p_{i,obs} = g_i+e_i
$$

After

$$
p_{i,obs} = g_i+e'_i
$$

where $var(e'_i)<var(e_i)$, and consequently $h_{adj}^2>h_{obs}^2$.

$$
y_{ijk} = \mu + C_k+B_j+G_i+e_{ijk}
$$

- $\mu$ Overal mean

- $C_k$ Vector of fixed checks effects

- $B_j$ Vector of fixed blocks effects

- $G_i$ Vector of random genotypes effects, $\sim N(0, I\sigma_g^2)$

- $e_{ijk}$ Vector of random residuals effects, $\sum N(0, I\sigma_e^2)$

```{r}
df$col.num <- as.numeric(trimws(df$col))
df$row.num <- as.numeric(trimws(df$row))

cross = list(down = 1:3, up = 1:3,
             left = 1:2, right = 1:2)

sketchGrid(i = 2, rowLimit = 3,
           j = 5, colLimit = 12,
           shapeCross = cross, excludeCenter = F, layers = NULL)

adj0 = movingGrid(rows = df$row.num,
                  columns = df$col.num,
                  obsPhe = df$value,
                  shapeCross = cross,
                  layers = NULL,
                  excludeCenter = F)

df$adj.value = adj0@adjustedPhe

M4 = asreml(adj.value ~ 1+check+rep,
            random = ~clone,
            na.action = na.method(x = 'include'),
            residual = ~idv(row):id(col),
            data = df)
M4 = update(M4)

AIC[4] = as.numeric(summary(M4)$aic[1])
BIC[4] = as.numeric(summary(M4)$bic[1])
H2[4] = as.numeric(vpredict(M4, H2~V1/(V1+V2)))

plot(varioGram(M4))
```

```{r}
M4r = asreml(adj.value~1+check+rep,
             na.action = na.method(x="include"),
             residual = ~idv(row):id(col),
             data = df)

lrt(M4, M4r)
```


#### **Model 5:** Nearest neighbour adjustment with Column as

$$
y_{ijkl} = \mu + C_k + B_j + F_l + G_i + e_{ijkl}
$$

- $\mu$ Overal mean

- $C_k$ Vector of fixed checks effects

- $B_j$ Vector of fixed blocks effects

- $F_l$ Vector of fixed column effects

- $G_i$ Vector of random genotypes effects, $\sim N(0, I\sigma_g^2)$

- $e_{eijkl}$ Vector of random residuals effects, $\sim N(0, I\sigma_e^2)$

```{r}
M5 = asreml(adj.value ~ 1+check+rep+Fcol,
            random = ~clone,
            na.action = na.method(x = 'include'),
            residual = ~idv(row):id(col),
            data = df)
M5 = update(M5)

rand = summary(M5, coef = T)$coef.random
pev = rand[,2]^2

s2g = summary(M5)$varcomp["clone", "component"]

r = sqrt(1-(mean(pev)/s2g))

AIC[5] = as.numeric(summary(M5)$aic[1])
BIC[5] = as.numeric(summary(M5)$bic[1])
H2[5] = as.numeric(vpredict(M5, H2~V1/(V1+V2)))
```


```{r}
M5r = asreml(adj.value ~ 1+check+rep+Fcol,
             na.action = na.method(x = "include"),
             residual = ~idv(row):id(col),
             data = df)

lrt(M5, M5r)
```

#### **Getting AIC, BIC, $H^2$ and $r$**

$$
H^2 = \frac{\sigma_g^2}{\sigma_g^2+\sigma_e^2}
$$

$$
r = \sqrt{H^2}
$$

```{r}
ans = data.frame(model = as.factor(paste0("M", 1:5)),
                 AIC, 
                 BIC, 
                 H2, 
                 r = sqrt(H2))
kable(ans, format = 'html')
```
